TC-01/S24.title: Real phone on the local stack: card tap, delete pop-up and toast, and a wrong device clock
TC-01/S24.detail: Android rig: debug build of main e02167f bundled for the LOCAL stack only (bundle names 127.0.0.1:4510/4511, reached through adb reverse), built outside the checkout, on the rc_api36 emulator (Pixel 7, Android 16); Playwright attached to the app's own WebView; every ai/* action the app sends is answered or failed at the WebView's socket (no model call; aiCallLog had no new row in any run). Our addition (10-15 review): recorded only; the failures seen are known. Card tap opens the chart. Delete on a throwaway Hospital patient: the confirmation is Android's system dialog (CANCEL / OK, not the app's own pop-up), CANCEL keeps the patient, OK removes it, and no 'deleted' message shows - known B24 (TFA-92579 AC 7 / AC 8). Nursing Home cards have no delete control (B24). Deleting a task asks nothing (recorded for TC-24/S24 / U8). Phone one day ahead, then one day ahead in UTC-10, reopened and compared with the web on the same account: the phone drops 'NEW TODAY' on every card, and a patient set to New Admission today and a resident set to Consult today read Follow-up on the phone but New Admission / Consult on the web - known B18 / TFA-92584 AC 8 (TFA-92579 AC 3/4 for 'New today'). Hospital day / visit number are not on the cards (B23).
